title: Connection
description: Canonical Connection contract per DEVOS-SPEC-025. A Connection represents configured connectivity to one external system. Credentials MUST NEVER be stored inline; they are expressed as Secret references only.

targetType.description: The kind of external system being reached.

endpoint.description: Declarative address or locator for the external system. Objects use named descriptor fields; strings use direct locators.

credentialSecretRefs.description: Identifiers of Secrets owned by the same Workspace. Inline credential values are invalid per DEVOS-SPEC-025 and DEVOS-SPEC-028.

options.description: Connection options consumed by the Connection Engine.

healthCheckHints.description: Hints consumed by the Health System defined in DEVOS-SPEC-046.
